_comment: Settings for the personal-coach pipeline (fetch -> analyze -> exercises).
_username_help: Your chess.com username. Everything else works once this is set.

thresholds._comment: Centipawn loss (from the mover's point of view) that defines each error class.
thresholds._verify_min_loss: Scan-loss a move needs before earning a deep verify.
thresholds._winning_cap: Evals are clamped to +/- this before differencing, so 'winning by more' isn't punished.

exercises._own_max_reps: Clean solves before one of your own blunder positions retires. Past 2 you are recalling the board, not learning the pattern -- the lessons take over from there.
exercises._lessons_max: How many lessons to diagnose. Each one is a diagnosis, a habit and a 3-rung drill ladder, so this is the real size of your daily practice.
